title: 2021 HMMT November Guts Problem 1
statement:
The graphs of the equations

\[\begin{aligned}
y & =-x+8 \\
173 y & =-289 x+2021
\end{aligned}\]

on the Cartesian plane intersect at \((a, b)\). Find \(a+b\).

solutions.text: From the first equation, it is known that ( \(a, b\) ) lies on the line \(x+y=8\), therefore \(a+b=8\).
